data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 5.7m (2021: GBP 120.9m) is a favourable development of GBP 20.5m (2021: deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) agreement with RiverStone
prior_year_events.impact_description: LPT agreement covering 2020 & prior years of account for Syndicate 1861, impacting prior year results and reinsurance recoveries. The narrative states it contributed to a net favourable development.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development cover contract with Canopius Reinsurance Limited (CRe)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate entered into an adverse development cover contract, ceding GBP 7,330k of premium to CRe. Reinsurance recoveries of GBP 5,208k were due from CRe.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 7.156m, primarily driven by adverse development on the 2020 underwriting year (+GBP 12.190m), partially offset by a release on the 2019 underwriting year (-GBP 5.034m). This movement is influenced by a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) agreement in December 2021 covering 2020 and prior years, and an adverse development cover contract in 2022. General economic inflation, exacerbated by geopolitical events like the war in Ukraine, also impacted claims costs. The reported net prior year development was a favourable GBP 20.5m, indicating significant reinsurance effects.
raw_causal_phrases: rapid increase in inflation, exacerbated by the effects of the war in Ukraine, is impacting insurers and reinsurers, driving up the cost of claims as well as other expenses.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is derived from the gross claims development triangle. There is a significant Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) in December 2021 covering 2020 & prior years, which likely impacts the reported claims development figures. The narrative text on page 17 states a net favourable development of GBP 20.5m, which differs significantly from the gross strengthening of GBP 7.156m derived from the claims development triangle. The gross figure is used as per instructions. The claims development table only shows 2019 and 2020 underwriting years.
